instructions: Read the scan header and the files in /inputs: voxel spacing, size, orientation, and any problem with the data. Write what you found for the later tasks.
doneWhen: The spacing and size come from the files themselves, with the file or header each came from.

instructions: Orient the stack so the later tasks share one frame (a labels-ready volume with known axes). Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: The orientation is checked on a render you looked at.

instructions: Segment the bones and joint structures and settle the final labels. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: Every label is one structure, checked on renders and component counts.
The volumes of #1-3 follow from the final labels.

instructions: Define the IIOC region (ROI-1) and report its volumes, heights and the tibial width. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: ROI-1 runs from the growth plate to the articular surface and was checked on a render.

instructions: Measure the subchondral bone plate thickness, medial and lateral. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: Each thickness is reported with the render it was read from.

instructions: Define ROI-2 (ROI-1 without the plate and the cortical line) and report its volumes. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: ROI-2 excludes the subchondral plate and the cortical line.

instructions: Define ROI-3 below the growth plate and report its trabecular parameters. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: ROI-3 starts 50 um below the growth plate, is 200 um long and 20 um clear of cortical bone.

instructions: Measure the cortical thickness 100 um and 1000 um below the growth plate. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: Both levels are measured on the same frame as ROI-3.

instructions: Place the femoral points and report the distal femoral length, width and their ratio. Follow references/oa-protocol.md and the orient-joint skill; the anatomy is in references/anatomy.md.
doneWhen: Points a-d are placed on renders and the lengths follow from them.
